Posy House Styling

The Guelph menu lists an individual session of about 1.5 hours at C$350 plus HST, using 16 categories. It describes a take-home card and a 45-colour swatch book delivered later. Group pricing is per person. The page advertises a launch discount, so confirm its current terms rather than assuming it remains available.

sections.title: Before booking in Guelph
sections.html:
Ask when the swatch book arrives and what you can use immediately after the appointment. If bringing makeup or natural-hair photos, follow the provider’s preparation instructions. For a group, confirm that every guest receives the same references and enough individual discussion. Do not assume that a virtual option is bookable when the website still describes it as coming soon.

  • What is the final price after HST and any currently valid promotion?
  • When will my swatch book arrive, and what do I receive on the day?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: Use the waiting period for any delivered materials to build a small outfit plan from existing clothes. Choose a neutral, two accents and one accessory, then note which combinations feel easy to wear. Stylist AI can help you explore those ideas on your phone. A live appointment adds physical comparison and conversation; choose it when that is the kind of support you want.
